given: a stock position whose batch or serial has no value
when: the operator views that stock position
then: the empty field displays an explicit 'none yet' indicator rather than being left blank, so the operator can tell the field is intentionally empty rather than missing

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts populated batch and serial render as distinct labelled values; AC2 asserts the empty branch shows an explicit 'none yet' placeholder. A view that renders populated values correctly could still leave an empty field blank, so this fails independently.
